description_en: Returns the account information of distributor customers
description_zh: 返回分销客户账号信息
name: GetAccountInfo

parameters.help_en: The UID of the distributor customer account. Either this parameter or the UserType parameter is required. If this parameter is left empty, all distributor customer accounts of the specified UserType are queried
parameters.help_zh: 分销客户账号UID，此参数和UserType参数必须有一个。如果此参数为空，则查询UserType类型的所有分销客户账号
parameters.name: uid

parameters.help_en:
The type of the distributor customer account. Valid values:
- 1: End User
- 2: enterprise customer 
- 3: T2 partner
parameters.help_zh:
分销客户账号类型，取值范围:
- 1 End User
- 2 企业客户 
- 3 T2伙伴
parameters.name: user_type

parameters.help_en: The page number of the current page
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: 20
parameters.name: page_size
